Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0437533 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
NZ
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
Recommended Actions to Perform On-Site:
Connection Inspection:
Verify all connections between KF1 and PH2 to ensure there are no loose connections. Confirm the integrity of DPP and USB connections for the OC display and touchscreen functionality.
Voltage Check:
Measure the supply voltage and ensure it is delivering a stable 24V.
Cable Testing:
Swap the DPP and USB cables with known working ones to rule out cable faults. Firmware Validation:
Ensure the D-Logic controller is updated to the latest firmware. Electrical & Wiring Checks:
Verify if FC-12 in the automation area has tripped. Inspect all wiring associated with the HMI and D-Logic controller for potential issues.
PCB Handling:
During updates or interventions, ensure the PCB is firmly connected. Handle the flat ribbon cable with care to avoid damage.
Site Visit Preparation:
Please ensure the spare parts HMI, DPP and USB cable are available during the visit for replacement, if necessary
For guidance, refer to the attached HMI schematic with marked components and additionally refer KA if all the schematic has been checked from your side.

additional_info.subject: 0437533 - ID0437533-DC/Si-D/NZ- [MP / P3 170000340] Screen not responding CRM:00312000117
additional_info.body:
Hey All,
Hope you're doing well.
As you may know, we've had some feedback from We.EV about their HMI not responding (even after replacing the HMI) on charger 170000340.
We would there like to suggest the following action:
1) Replace USB cable to the HMI
2) Replace the DP cable to the HMI
3) Update the HMI firmware (done locally on the charger).
Do you still have any remaining DP cables in stock?
For the USB cable, we will need to examine and estimate this based off a charger in stock.
This USB cable runs from KF1 PLC and does to the HMI.
It is Type A on KF1 end and USB C on the HMI end, estimating about 1.4m.
This should be the black USB cable in KF1, If you could review it locally and see if there are any markings to indicate any additional information, as this will need to be acquired locally.
For the updating the HMI firmware on the display, it would be best to setup a meeting before hand.
This could even be done on a charger in your warehouse first to practice the process and then do it in the field.
For the update, among hand tools an I2C to USB A Cable is required.
Please let me know when we can schedule this and also with whom.
Thanks.
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility

Hey Wilson,
Hope you are doing well.
Would you be able to let me know Lucky's availability for a job in Hamilton NZ?

This is for a SiCharge D and there are several steps we would need to take and parts required.

additional_info.body:
Hello Liz,
This issue was reported by the customer during their active warranty period.
As the issue is very intermittent and random to re-produce this means it has taken some time to evalaute the underlying issue and progressive fault finding has led us to this point.
As it was only reported for this charger, only this charger will have the work completed under it, as the other charger has been operational without fault.
Both of these chargers are now outside of warranty.
Yes, in order to complete a successful LOTO and make the charger safe to work on, the charger must be isolated at the switchboard.
With Kind regards,
